derived_measures.note: Coordinates are CRS84 (WGS 84 lon/lat) as required by RFC 7946 section 4, which removed the GeoJSON crs member; every *_declared area and length property in this file was computed in EPSG:4548 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 117E).

properties.closure_note_zh: 附合路线在 BM-0 闭合：末站取读数后回到水准原点复算闭合差。回程沿主脊 ROAD-001 步行，不是本要素画出的直线——因此几何在末站结束，闭合关系记在 closes_at 上。把回程画成直线曾使本要素自相交，并凭空断言了一条穿越城市的可步行直线。
properties.closure_note_en: The circuit closes at BM-0: after the last station the surveyor returns to the origin benchmark and computes the misclosure. The return leg is walked along the spine (ROAD-001), so this geometry ends at the last station and the closure is recorded in closes_at rather than drawn.
properties.role_zh: AI场景验证的附合路线：自水准原点起测，沿途各站独立取读数，返回原点计算闭合差

properties.role_zh: 把离轴测点接入主脊的步行支线。测点必须可步行抵达才能被复测，而附合路线是测量弦线、不是通道，两者不可互相顶替。
properties.alignment_basis_zh: 线位取测点至主脊的最近点连线，属概念建议：它表达「此处缺一条步行连接」这一需求与其量级，不是定线，不是道路红线，不代表沿途可通行或已征得权属同意，实施须经交通与权属专项论证。
properties.alignment_basis_en: Drawn as the straight connection from the benchmark to its nearest point on the spine. It is an agent-proposed alignment stating that a walkable link is missing here and roughly how long it is -- not a survey line, not a road boundary, and no claim that the ground between is passable.
